name: ChartObjects
description: A collection of all the ChartObject objects on the specified chart sheet, dialog sheet, or worksheet.
remarks: Each ChartObject object represents an embedded chart. The ChartObject object acts as a container for a Chart object. Properties and methods for the ChartObject object control the appearance and size of the embedded chart on the sheet.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the objects are locked.

properties.name: Placement
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value, containing an XlPlacement constant, that represents the way the objects are attached to the cells below them.

properties.name: PrintObject
properties.description: True if the objects will be printed when the document is printed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the object.

properties.name: ShapeRange
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents the specified object or objects. Read-only.

properties.name: ProtectChartObject
properties.description: True if the embedded chart frame cannot be moved, resized, or deleted through the user interface. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: CopyPicture
methods.signature: CopyPicture([Appearance As XlPictureAppearance], [Format As XlCopyPictureFormat]) As Variant
methods.description: Copies the selected object to the Clipboard as a picture. Variant.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: Specifies how the picture should be copied. The default value is xlScreen.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The format of the picture. The default value is xlPicture.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Cuts the object to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the object and returns a reference to the new copy.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: True to replace the current selection with the specified object. False to extend the current selection to include any previously selected objects and the specified object.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the object to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Left As Double, Top As Double, Width As Double, Height As Double) As ChartObject

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The initial coordinates of the new object (in points), relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet or to the upper-left corner of a chart.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial size of the new object, in points.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.
